title: Ephesians Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Ephesians 5: walking as children of light, being filled with the Spirit, and husbands and wives.

questions.text: Whom does verse 1 tell them to imitate, as beloved children?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says "Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children."

questions.text: What does the text say Christ gave himself up for us as?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

answers.text: A ransom paid to the rulers and powers of this age
A sign given to the nations that were far off
A seal set on the assembly until the day of redemption
An offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance

questions.text: Who, according to verse 5, has no inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

answers.text: No sexually immoral, unclean or covetous person
No one who has not been taught the law
No one who eats what is unclean
No one who keeps company with Gentiles

questions.text: What does verse 8 say they once were, and what are they now?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says they were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord, and tells them to walk as children of light.

answers.text: Once slaves, now heirs of the law
Once darkness, now light in the Lord
Once dead, now asleep in the Lord

questions.text: According to the saying quoted in verse 14, what will Christ do for the one who awakes?
questions.explanation: The quoted words are "Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

questions.text: Why does the text tell them to redeem the time?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says they are to redeem the time, because the days are evil.

questions.text: Instead of being drunken with wine, what are they told to be?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says not to be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but to be filled with the Spirit.

questions.text: Of what does verse 23 say Christ is the head?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

questions.text: How does verse 26 say Christ cleansed the assembly?
questions.explanation: Verse 26 says he sanctified it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word.

answers.text: By the laying on of hands
By the washing of water with the word

questions.text: What does the last verse of the chapter tell the wife to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 33 says each husband must love his own wife as himself, and that the wife should see that she respects her husband.

answers.text: See that she respects her husband
